pages.title: Tidal Ore
pages.text: A seam of metal pulled thin by gravity gradients. One end of every grain feels a stronger pull than the other, and the ore is threaded with stretch marks. It flexes slightly in the hand, as if still being tugged.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Tidal forces are the difference in gravity across an object. Deep in infall rock I found metal that had been stretched rather than crushed, and recognised the signature of a nearby singularity.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the black hole interior (mine it for its drop).
